info.title: CityTurfer API
info.description:
The CityTurfer HTTP API: the app's use cases (Activity Log, Territory, Identity, Achievements) over HTTP, for backup, sync across devices and future clients.

**Status:** routes marked `x-cityturfer-status: planned` are designed and answer `501` until they are built (docs/decisions/api-2026-10-20.md).

**Conventions:** JSON in camelCase; SI units with a suffix (`distanceM`, `movingS`); ISO 8601 UTC timestamps; coordinates `[lon, lat]`; bounding boxes `[west, south, east, north]`; errors as `application/problem+json`.

**Privacy:** GPS tracks are personal data. They belong to the user, can be exported (`GET /v1/me/export`) and erased (`DELETE /v1/me`), and are never logged.

bearerAuth.description: Token from POST /v1/auth/sign-in (mock, dev only; Better Auth later).

ETag.description: Version of the resource; send it back in `If-Match` to change it.

Location.description: Where the created resource or job lives.

RateLimit.description: Remaining quota of the current window (IETF RateLimit header).

token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header.

detail.description: For people; never holds input values or coordinates.

errors.description: Only on 400 `invalid-request`: which fields are invalid.

ProblemCode.description: Stable machine code (catalogue in the API description, "Errors").

code.description: Why it is invalid (zod issue code).

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null at the end.

estimatedDistanceM.description: Part of distanceM estimated along streets over GPS gaps.

id.description: H3 cell index (res 11, or coarser when aggregated).

get.description: Public. Answers when the function is up; touches no data.

post.description: Exchanges credentials for a bearer token. Mock `admin` account first; Better Auth later.

put.description: Creates the activity with its track under the id the phone minted, or answers with the stored one if it already exists (idempotent; use case ImportActivity). The server computes distance, time, splits and claims turf from the track. Bodies are limited to 4.5 MB: send gzip (`Content-Encoding: gzip`) for long tracks.
